didascalia:
How we score your Instagram bio 📏

Every list we publish uses the same rubric: the Cool Score. Five criteria, ten points.

First rule: you must have posted in the last 30 days. Dormant accounts don't make our lists.

Personality, 3 pts: does it sound like a person?
Clarity, 2 pts: do we get what you do in 3 seconds?
Call to action, 2 pts: do we know what to do next?
Details, 1 pt: short lines, smart emoji, zero typos.
Feed, 2 pts: does your grid keep your bio's promise?

Full marks examples from our lists: @honeybeecrochetstudio @curlsbyeightysixed @rabbottinteriors @thesoapbubblehaus @sammys_cakes_
